data.body: Phase 2 local repair complete. RED: alias regression failed for both `rebar~main~Icanonical` and `rebar~986`; rerun-producer regression failed because REST `id` won over canonical `change_id`. GREEN: artifact reuse now keys the immutable revision across Gerrit display aliases while preserving the first readable title; manual rerun prefers `ChangeInfo.change_id` with existing fallbacks. Held-out oracle and canonical producer test both passed; defect-seeded mutations restored both failures, then the fix was restored. Verification: 90 passed / 4 skipped across focused review-bot files; `make lint` passed; `make typecheck` passed; module sizes voter.py=749 and gerrit_client.py=365 (under 800); end-to-end local reproduction returned one artifact for original I… then rebar~986. Full `make test` was manually interrupted without observed failure after ~2% because its local runtime was disproportionate; Gerrit Verified remains required before submit. Sibling sweep found no confirmed additional occurrence requiring code in this change. Existing live duplicate data remains unreconciled pending an explicit operator decision.
